messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a kernel + quant-profile rollout during the next maintenance window. Target Thu 3/26 23:00 UTC. Canary plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Need rollout owner, smoke checklist, and rollback readiness.
Sam: I can own the rollout. Will claim slots and coordinate canaries. Prefer starting with a small GPU pool slice 3 -> then expand.
Lee: Oncall availability? I can hop in for the 2nd hour for metrics deep-dive.
Taylor: I can cover first hour (23:00–00:00 UTC) and run initial smoke. Post results here.
Sam: Quick inline smoke checklist (we'll also run these from the smoke-runner job):
- 1) Basic liveness: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood/v1/health` -> expect 200
- 2) Latency smoke: `ab -n 100 -c 5 https://api.redwood/v1/generate?model=canary` -> p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms
- 3) KV cache sanity: `curl -s https://metrics.redwood/kv_cache_evictions?window=5m` -> evictions ~0; mem_pressure low
- 4) Functional sample: run eval set diff with quant flag, script below:
```bash
python infra/evals/run_diff.py --baseline-model=engine-v2 --candidate=engine-v2-q4_1 \
  --samples=50 --output=tmp/diffs.json
```
- 5) Error budget check: error_rate < 0.5% across routes, and no increase in model-mismatch alerts.
Maria: Quant profile bump is q4_0 -> q4_1 for this rollout. Expect ~10-15% infer perf improvement, small token-level variance on ~1% of samples.
Sam: Rollback plan: if any smoke fails or metrics breach thresholds, we flip profile back with this API call:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"profile":"q4_0"}' \
  https://control-plane.internal/v1/models/engine-v2/profile
```
Also have image fallback: `engine-v2:2026-03-01` tagged and ready to re-deploy.
deploy-bot: slot claimed by Sam for window 2043217000-2043217600 (canary slice assigned: slice-c-7).
Taylor: I'll run checks 1–3 and paste p50/p95 numbers here. If p50 > 120ms or error_rate > 0.5% we pause and escalate.
Sam: Creating canary PR #4567 with rollout steps and smoke checklist. @Lee please watch `kv_cache_evictions`, `mem_pressure`, and `slot_cpu_steal`. Also watch `generator_errors` and `rerank_failures`.
Lee: Ack — will watch dashboards and set a 5m alert if evictions > 5 in window.
Maria: I've added runbook + preflight checklist to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/engine-quant-upgrade (link internal). Also tagging infra for any slot claim hiccups.
Sam: Final checklist before start: 1) slot claim confirmed (done), 2) smoke-runner scheduled, 3) oncall set (Taylor 1st hr, Lee takeover), 4) rollback API keys verified. If no objections I'll start canary at 23:00 UTC.
Taylor: No objections from me. Posting reminder 10m before start. :thumbsup:
Sam: will ping again when canary starts and post smoke outputs.
Maria: Thanks — keep this thread updated. If we see any unexpected model quality regression, pause at once and roll back.
